v1.feedback: The shader applies continuous Y-axis form rotation (`uTwist * uTime * 0.12`) which is a banned motion pattern — even at ~0.002 rad/frame, it is unceasing Y-spin of the Möbius geometry; replace it with a single slow non-Y drift that stops, or make the rotation a deliberate reveal that halts after one pass and then holds a contemplative fixed view. The L-system-to-Möbius mapping is mathematically inventive and the soft-erupt Chladni eruption is a legitimate surprise, but the harmattan wind erosion plus the nodal eruption plus the continuous spin stack three competing motion systems — kill the spin and let the eruption breathe as the sole event. Verify the fragment shader palette in the truncated section avoids any HSL >65% saturation; the visible background (0x0e0b08) is excellent.
